component.name: FetchLibraryTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetchLibrary" end sub
sub fetchLibrary() m.top.state = "loading"
playlists = LoadPlaylists() if playlists.Count() = 0 m.top.error = "No playlists saved" m.top.state = "error" return end if
selectedIndex = m.top.selectedIndex if selectedIndex < 0 then selectedIndex = 0 if selectedIndex > playlists.Count() then selectedIndex = 0
allChannels = [] failed = [] loadedCount = 0
if selectedIndex = 0 for pIdx = 0 to playlists.Count() - 1 loadPlaylistIntoLibrary(playlists[pIdx], pIdx, allChannels, failed) end for loadedCount = playlists.Count() - failed.Count() else pIdx = selectedIndex - 1 loadPlaylistIntoLibrary(playlists[pIdx], pIdx, allChannels, failed) if failed.Count() = 0 then loadedCount = 1 end if
if allChannels.Count() = 0 message = "No channels found." if failed.Count() > 0 message = message + " " + failed.Join(" | ") end if m.top.error = message m.top.state = "error" return end if
warning = "" if failed.Count() > 0 warning = Str(failed.Count()).Trim() + " playlist(s) could not be loaded." end if
m.top.channels = { items: allChannels, count: allChannels.Count(), playlistCount: loadedCount, failedCount: failed.Count(), warning: warning } m.top.state = "done" end sub
sub loadPlaylistIntoLibrary(playlist as Object, playlistIndex as Integer, allChannels as Object, failed as Object) result = HttpGet(playlist.url, "", 0) if not result.ok failed.Push(playlist.name + ": " + IIF(result.error <> invalid, result.error, "network error")) return end if
channels = ParseM3U(result.body) if channels.Count() = 0 failed.Push(playlist.name + ": no channels found") return end if
for cIdx = 0 to channels.Count() - 1 ch = channels[cIdx] ch.playlistId = IIF(playlist.id <> invalid, playlist.id, "") ch.playlistName = IIF(playlist.name <> invalid, playlist.name, "Playlist") ch.playlistIndex = playlistIndex ch.channelIndex = cIdx ch.libraryId = ch.playlistId + ":" + Str(cIdx).Trim() allChannels.Push(ch) end for end sub
